title: MEDT insights into the mechanism and selectivity of the (3 + 2) cycloaddition of (Z)-N-methyl-C-(2-furyl)-nitrone with but-2-ynedioic acid and the bioactivity of the reaction products
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32271-32283
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04143K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohamed Chellegui, Lakhdar Benhamed, Raad Nasrullah Salih, Ines Salhi, Sofiane Benmetir, Ali Ben Ahmed, Haydar A. Mohammad-Salim, Jesus Vicente de Julián-Ortize
DFT calculations reveal that the (3 + 2) cycloaddition between (Z)-N-methyl furyl nitrone and but-2-ynedioic acid favors CA3-Z diastereoselectivity via a one-step polar process. Docking and predictions show promising drug potential.
